title: Material Receiving & Freight Damage
short_answer: Inspect and count at the truck — photos and ticket notes beat a claim filed after unload.
summary: Stocking tells you where to put good material.
plain_words: Stocking tells you where to put good material. This page is the gate that keeps bad material off the floor. If it is wet, crushed, or the wrong specialty board, it does not get staged "for later."
prerequisites: Read drawings and finish schedule before acting

steps.body: Photo damage on the truck before unload when you see wet wrap, broken corners, or bent studs.

steps.title: Reject or quarantine unusable material
steps.body: call the lead/office/supplier path the job uses. Do not hide it in a closet.
